name: Sheldon Joseph Dolan
sources: Ancestry.com, Washington, U.S., Marriage Records, 1854-2013 (Robert Joseph Dolan and Marrion P. Hinds, Vancouver, Clark County, 9 Jun 1937)
Ancestry.com, 1940 United States Federal Census (Brentwood, Multnomah County, Oregon; ED 26-58, sheets 7B–8A)
Find a Grave, memorial 45057982 (Sheldon Joseph Dolan, Mount Calvary Cemetery, Portland)
notes: Born 1 Mar 1909 in Portland, Oregon; died 20 Jul 1942, aged 33, and was buried at Mount Calvary Cemetery, Portland, next to his mother (Find a Grave).

As Robert Joseph Dolan, 28, of Portland, he married Marrion P. Hinds, 18, at Vancouver, Washington, on 9 Jun 1937; the record names his parents as Martine Joseph Dolan and May Dolan (Washington marriage records). In 1940, as Sheldon J. Dolan, 31, a stevedore, he lived at the rear of 6557 S.E. 67th Avenue, Brentwood, Multnomah County, with Marrion and their daughter Mary.
